name: LinkaPilot
summary: A new aviation job platform for pilots, engineers, cabin crew and aviation companies, reported by Spain's Hispaviación on October 17. It analyzes and structures CV information to assess how well a candidate fits an opening, leaves the selection decision with people, and verifies the identity of professionals and companies before they join.
paragraphs: A new aviation job platform for pilots, engineers, cabin crew and aviation companies, reported by Spain's Hispaviación on October 17. It analyzes and structures CV information to assess how well a candidate fits an opening, leaves the selection decision with people, and verifies the identity of professionals and companies before they join.
whyItMatters: Generic job boards bury a type rating or a licence under keyword noise, so recruiters end up paying agencies to find people who were already applying. A platform that reads aviation qualifications properly can shorten the time to a shortlist. It is new and early: post one hard-to-fill role and compare the matches with your current channels before paying for anything.
